cat > /tmp/bug_stress.csv <<'EOF'
id,name,city,comment
1,"Doe, Jane",Boston,"river, harbor, and trails"
2,"Smith, John " "III",Salem,""quoted"", ok
EOF
echo "--- workspace .venv python ---"; .venv/bin/python fmtcsv.py /tmp/bug_stress.csv
echo "--- system /opt/venv python ---"; /opt/venv/bin/python fmtcsv.py /tmp/bug_stress.csv
echo "--- other fmtcsv on PATH? ---"; which fmtcsv || echo "no fmtcsv binary on PATH"
rm /tmp/bug_stress.csv
title: Stress-test quoted-comma handling across interpreters
